high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from analyticsindiamag.com, featuring an article titled "Where Are All the Early AI Unicorns." The page displays a tweet from Andrew Kean Gao (@itsandrewgao) dated March 19, asking about the status of early AI unicorns like Jasper. Below the tweet, there is a reply from cole (@colecallinan), stating that these companies have been scamming him out of $499.99 a year even though he canceled it after the first day. The main body of the article discusses the challenges faced by startups in the AI industry,
